subject: Transportation Systems
title: TEU: The Unit That Measures Trade
description: One-minute skill: TEU: The Unit That Measures Trade.

hook.text: In shipping, everything is measured in TEUs—twenty-foot equivalent units.

buildup.text: One TEU is a standard 20-foot container. Most containers today are 40 feet, so they count as two TEUs.

discovery.text: The world moves over 800 million TEUs per year. That's roughly one container per ten people on Earth.

twist.text: TEU capacity keeps growing. Ships from 2000 carried 8,000 TEUs. Today's giants carry over 24,000.

climax.text: Economists track TEU volumes the way they track GDP—it's a direct pulse of global commerce.

punchline.text: Global trade is counted in metal boxes.
